notes.title: Update Veiled Whispers
notes.notes:
We’ve made the decision to move the release of Veiled Whispers to 2026. This wasn’t easy, but it’s the right step. We’re committed to delivering a truly immersive and atmospheric horror experience – and that means giving the game the time it needs to reach its full potential.

For more details and behind-the-scenes updates, visit our website:
👉 [url=schimiongames.de]Schimion Games[/url]

Thank you for your patience and continued support!
– Daniel

Story Updates not available!

Gameplay Additions:

Added main menu
Added save and load functionality
Added language options
Gameplay Changes:

Lightning intervals are now completely random
Thunder occurs randomly afterward
Lightning now has random brightness levels
Atmosphere is even denser and darker
Thunder delay increased (Previously 5-20 seconds, Now 7-20 seconds)
Lens flares slightly reduced
Film grain made slightly more pleasant
Flashlight light has some movement
Shadow issues fixed
Gameplay Fixes:

Game no longer hangs on non-single events
Removed "Hello Test" from triggers
No more significant lag when saving (switched to async)

notes.title: ALPHA 0.0.1
notes.notes: In the Alpha we just test the Gameplay Features. Have Fun and I hope we can make one of the Best Horror Games aviable.
